content: QR-from-file (no camera): native BarcodeDetector is 0-byte when present but missing/disabled in Firefox and Safari-by-default. jsQR is unmaintained (2021) and slow on 1080p+ photos. @zxing/library is ~117kB gzip all-formats. zxing-wasm / barcode-detector ponyfill pull ~1MB WASM. paulmillr/qr is a small QR-only decoder. html5-qrcode is camera-first and out of scope. Always File/Blob via input, revokeObjectURL, cap image pixels, do not POST the file.
